why: Records is one destination with two tabs, and switching tabs REPLACES the top layer -- so the tab that was clicked belongs to the pane being left and is not on the destination Back returns to. Recording it as the opener makes `restoreFocus` fall through to the container on every Back out of the Achievements tab, silently losing a keyboard player's place at the Main Menu control they actually used. Issue #318's whole point, in the one place issue #226 could break it. Re-anchored when the handler gained the in-document tab memory (issue #322): the opener argument is unchanged, but the line above it is new.
killedBy: hud: achievements is one destination with two tabs: switching keeps the Main Menu as the origin
